title: Kenworth T610 FUPS Compliant Custom Polished Alloy Road Train Bullbar #45
description: Kenworth T610 hi-tensile FUPS deep channel style Road Train Bullbar. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm pipe can be ordered. High tensile aluminium 6mm wall thickness box uprights for maximum strength. Optional aluminium reversible Road Train/ Long Vehicle signs on alloy plates. The bull bar can be custom built to your specification. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin resulting in 80kg weight saving. Custom driving light mounts can be fitted as required.
